<CLT=cltMIND>It's...back to normal?
Did Monokuma...clean everything up?
<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.
<CLT=cltMIND>But just seeing it makes me feel sick...

<CLT=cltMIND>This looks like a shower room.
...I don't have to take a shower right now.

<CLT=cltMIND>I wish I could have seen Ryoma
standing here...
